name: tthings

supported_platforms.linux-x86_64: tested SteamOS glibc 2.43; native symbols require >=2.42
supported_platforms.windows: source compatible; no native build or real OS validation
supported_platforms.macos: source compatible; no native build or real OS validation

prerequisites.linux_runtime: glibc >=2.42, UTF-8 terminal; no fastfetch needed
prerequisites.source: Python >=3.10; psutil on Windows/macOS, tzdata where system zoneinfo is absent
prerequisites.region: Linux desktop, Qt6 QML, KWin helpers; live desktop integration unverified

stop.protocol: SIGINT verified registered prefix processes, wait; Linux tested. Before first managed install ttools must stop its own legacy process.

terminal_title: OSC0: tthings — function · section; Konsole also OSC30 %w, previous tab format restored at exit
